2607.07508.title: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2607.07508.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is becoming increasingly important for post-training large language models (LLMs). Previous RL pipelines for LLMs were mostly synchronous and batch-interleaved, which is inefficient for long-horizon agentic tasks. Recently, asynchronous RL has emerged as a more efficient alternative by updating the model as rollouts arrive. However, existing asynchronous RL systems often emphasize throughput, while leaving training stability and task effectiveness largely underexplored. For example, a key challenge is that group-wise sampling in the widely-used GRPO framework does not naturally fit asynchronous agentic training. In this paper, we present Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO) to address the stability and off-policy challenges in asynchronous RL. To reduce off-policy effects and improve generalization, we replace group-wise sampling with single-rollout sampling, that is, using one rollout per prompt. We further improve this single-rollout strategy with practical value-model training designs. To improve optimization stability, we introduce a strict double-side token-level clipping strategy. SAO is able to train stably for one thousand steps and consistently outperform GRPO and its variants on agentic coding and reasoning benchmarks, such as SWE-Bench Verified, BeyondAIME, and IMOAnswerBench. We also demonstrate that single-rollout RL is particularly effective in a simulated online learning setting, where the model must adapt to changing evolving environments. To this end, SAO is successfully deployed in the agentic RL pipeline for training the open GLM-5.2 model (750B-A40B).
2607.07508.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習（RL）在大型語言模型（LLMs）後訓練中變得越來越重要。以往的LLMs強化學習流程大多是同步且批次交錯的，這對於長期代理任務來說效率不高。最近，非同步強化學習作為一種更高效的替代方案出現，通過在回合到達時更新模型。然而，現有的非同步強化學習系統往往強調吞吐量，而在訓練穩定性和任務有效性方面則大多未被深入探討。例如，一個關鍵挑戰是，在廣泛使用的GRPO框架中，群組取樣並不自然適合非同步代理訓練。在本文中，我們提出了單回合非同步優化（SAO），以解決非同步強化學習中的穩定性和脫政策挑戰。為了減少脫政策效應並改善泛化，我們用單回合取樣替換了群組取樣，即每個提示使用一個回合。我們進一步通過實用的價值模型訓練設計來改進這一單回合策略。為了提高優化穩定性，我們引入了一種嚴格的雙側標記級別剪裁策略。SAO能夠穩定訓練一千步，並在代理編碼和推理基準上，如SWE-Bench Verified、BeyondAIME和IMOAnswerBench，持續超越GRPO及其變體。我們還展示了單回合強化學習在模擬在線學習環境中特別有效，在這種環境中，模型必須適應不斷變化的環境。為此，SAO成功地部署在代理強化學習流程中，以訓練開放的GLM-5.2模型（750B-A40B）。
